content.note: all_three_pairwise_distinct is two-directional and is not labelled deploy-lag. only_*_differs is one-directional (two trees match).

instrument: sha256 of LF-normalized bytes per path per tree, reported as a 3-way partition

one_byte_control.description: Introduce a one-byte content change in exactly one tree and confirm the comparator reports exactly one divergent path, not zero and not all. A CRLF-only sibling in the mutated tree must stay identical after LF normalisation.

two_directional_control.description: Three pairwise-distinct hashes on one shared path must be reported as all_three_pairwise_distinct, not as a one-directional deploy lag.
